entries.title: Best Hydrate in U of Alberta’s Folio
entries.summary: U of Alberta’s Folio reports on Dr. Spencer Proctor’s collaboration with Best Hydrate and the research questions shaping oral hydration.
entries.body:
In U of Alberta’s Folio, Bev Betkowski reports on Dr. Spencer Proctor’s collaboration with Best Hydrate and a review of oral-hydration research. The article describes plans to compare and improve formulations, alongside questions for future research.

Source article published: October 8, 2026. This News entry is a later addition to our coverage archive.

Read our Folio coverage page

Read the original reporting in U of Alberta’s Folio

Coverage and research collaboration do not imply a product endorsement or a completed product efficacy trial.

entries.title: Best Hydrate on CBC Edmonton AM
entries.summary: CBC Edmonton AM introduces Best Hydrate founder Austin Swiniarski and chief scientific officer Spencer Proctor. Listen to the original interview.
entries.body:
CBC Edmonton AM introduces Best Hydrate founder Austin Swiniarski and chief scientific officer Spencer Proctor in a segment about the Sherwood Park company.

CBC’s headline is A sports drink that could help with Crohn's disease. That wording is attributed to CBC; it does not establish that Best Hydrate treats Crohn’s disease or that a product efficacy trial has been completed.
